bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • application: add bulk archive and delete session confirm actions (9faa9ab)
  • cli: adopt structured version probe across providers and health checks (8c60941)
  • claudehelper: harden CLI version probe with failure categories (f2718a5)

HagiCode-org/web

  • confirmDialog: add bulk archive and delete session confirm actions (381a653)
  • kanban: sort repositories by git priority and keep order on expand (b085a1d)
  • statusbar: add store bag icon and refine ms-store link styling (abf030d)
  • preset-task: rename Preset Task to HagiTask and support remote prompt input (db58d3c)
  • session: add bulk multi-select archive and delete to session list (959ed41)
